AI IMAGE GENERATOR

TEAM OF AI ASSISTANTS

AI SUMMARY CREATOR

AI PRODUCTIVITY PARTNER

AI OBJECT IDENTIFIER

Identify anything with Lena! Whether you need to recognize a plant or an unfamiliar landmark, just take a photo, and the AI chat app will give you information about it.

AI STORY GENERATOR

Dive into storytelling, easily crafting illustrated novels for both children and adults. Need to describe something or somewhere? The AI story writer will provide detailed descriptions to ignite readers' imaginations.

AI SOCIAL MEDIA BOOSTER

Whether it's creating captions for Instagram, developing ideas for TikTok, or scripting content for YouTube, this AI writer and content generator, powered by ChatGPT and GPT-4, is here to help.

AI CHATBOT WITH CUSTOM INSTRUCTIONS

• Chat fully offline, on a plane, abroad, anywhere: no signal needed, no data leaving your phone.

• Voice conversations, skills you can teach it, scheduled routines, document scanning into a private knowledge base.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

record.description_evidence:
Ask AI anything with Short Circuit. As an AI-powered chatbot, Shorty is here to revolutionize the way we communicate with our devices. Shorty can provide intelligent, sophisticated, and even funny responses to your every question, powered by the latest OpenAI models like ChatGPT and GPT-4, all with no ads.

But that's not all – Short Circuit is also integrated with Siri and Shortcuts, allowing you to seamlessly launch the app and ask your questions hands-free, through your favorite voice assistant. Whether you want to brainstorm, have a question, or want to do some research, Shorty is here to make your life easier.

And the more you use Short Circuit the more Shorty learns. Shorty uses your conversations to get smarter and provide better answers, so why not give it a try today and experience the power of AI chatbot technology integrated with Siri Shortcuts? Your productivity will thank you.

POWERED BY GPT
Short Circuit is powered by the latest OpenAI models, ChatGPT and GPT-4. Now you have the a personal tutor, a storyteller, or even a programming companion, no matter what you want to know.

ASK ANYTHING WITH SIRI
All you have to do is say, "Ask Shorty”, and our helpful bot Shorty will use the latest GPT models to find the best answer for your question. You can even configure what phrase Shorty responds to, there's a whole world of possibilities.

SHORTCUTS SUPPORT TOO
If you're a fan of Apple's Shortcuts app you're going to be a fan of Short Circuit. Short Circuit lets you build custom workflows to integrate the latest GPT has to offer into your life with the ultimate flexibility.

FACT CHECKS
You can't always trust what you read, so Short Circuit makes sure you can fact check anything Shorty says. But he's honest, we promise.

And so much more coming.

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

Short Circuit offers three auto-renewing subscription options:
$2.99 per month
$5.99 per month
$14.99 per month

These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.

Terms Of Service are available here: https://api.shortcircuit.chat/terms-of-service

Privacy policy is available here: https://api.shortcircuit.chat/privacy-policy

DISCLAIMER

- Do not enter personal information.
- Generated responses may be offensive or dangerous, please use your best judgment when using Short Circuit.
- Short Circuit is not liable for content generated.
- This app is not affiliated with OpenAI, please use this according to the Open AI usage guidelines.

WHY ATOMIC CHAT

- 100% on-device AI — models run locally using your device's Neural Engine
- Complete privacy — your chats never leave your iPhone
- Works offline — no internet required after initial model download
- No account needed — open the app and start chatting
- Free to use — no subscriptions, no hidden fees

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Ask questions and get instant answers
- Brainstorm ideas and get creative suggestions
- Draft emails, messages, and documents
- Summarize text and extract key points
- Translate between languages
- Get help with writing, coding, and learning
- Have natural, flowing conversations on any topic

Pick from a curated selection of open-source language models optimized for mobile. Download once, use forever. Swap models anytime based on your needs — smaller models for speed, larger models for depth.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY

Atomic Chat processes everything locally on your device. Your prompts, your conversations, and your data never touch a server. There is no telemetry, no analytics tracking your conversations, and no third-party AI providers.

Atomic Chat is built to take full advantage of modern iPhone and iPad hardware, delivering fast response times and efficient battery usage through Apple's Neural Engine.

PERFECT FOR

- Privacy-conscious users who don't want their conversations in the cloud
- Travelers and commuters who need AI without internet
- Professionals handling sensitive information
- Anyone curious about running AI on their own device
